summary: LDAP connector started returning encoded group attribute values; RBAC bindings fail in private deployment
description:
Issue summary: After a vendor upgrade to the LDAP connector, SCIM provisioning began transmitting the group/memberOf attribute values Base64-encoded instead of plain Distinguished Names (DNs). The identity stack's normalization path did not decode the values, so role-to-group mappings in RBAC failed to match, producing widespread 403s for admin users and service accounts.

Impact: Several FinSight admin users and automation service accounts lost administrative access to the private control plane (console and admin API). Customer reports inability to perform tenant admin tasks and manage model rollouts. Incidence started after vendor connector rollout at ~2026-03-01T02:00 UTC.

Environment: Private deployment (VPC) running control-plane v1.8.2, identity-proxy v2.4.5, scim-provisioner v0.14.0. Customer region: us-east-1. Affected tenants: fin_sight_prod.

Steps to reproduce:
1) Authenticate via corporate SSO (LDAP-backed) as a user known to have admin roles.
2) Access /console or call admin API endpoints (e.g., /v1/admin/models).
3) Observe 403 Forbidden for previously-authorized principals.
4) Inspect assertion headers forwarded by identity-proxy (X-User-Groups / X-Assertion-memberOf) and SCIM payloads; values appear Base64-encoded (e.g., "YmFzZV9ncnVwPQ==").

Logs / Observations:
- identity-proxy logs show incoming header X-Assertion-memberOf: "YmFzZV9kbi1vYmplY3Q9RmluU2lnaCxlbnY9ZW50cHA="
- RBAC service chaîne: "no matching role mapping for group 'YmFzZV9kbi1vYmplY3Q='"
- Grafana: spike in 403s from admin endpoints beginning 2026-03-01T02:10 UTC; error trace IDs: trc-4a8b2f, trc-4a8b3c.

Customer-provided artifacts: sample assertion header, SCIM member JSON, and screenshots attached in ticket (customer_claims.json, scim_payload.json).
comments: 2026-03-01 09:12 - Aisha Khan (Support): Initial contact with FinSight. Confirmed loss of admin access. Asked for sample assertion header and SCIM payload; customer provided files.
2026-03-01 10:05 - Liam O'Connor (SRE): Reproduced 403s in a staging mirror. Observed group values Base64-encoded in incoming headers. Hypothesis: upstream connector changed serialization format.
2026-03-01 13:40 - FinSight (Customer): Vendor indicates they shipped connector v3.2 which intentionally Base64-encodes group strings for transport safety. They can toggle legacy mode on request.

2026-03-02 02:20 - Liam O'Connor (SRE): Implemented a temporary RBAC mapping to accept encoded DNs for fin_sight_prod tenant to restore admin access. Verified console access returned for affected admins.
2026-03-03 15:55 - POO (Engineering): Ran a canary of identity-proxy v2.4.6 that includes decode step for memberOf prior to normalization; no regressions observed on canary hosts.
2026-03-04 08:30 - Aisha Khan (Support): Customer confirmed functionality restored and performing validation of automation jobs.
investigation_notes: Confirmed timeline correlates with vendor connector release at 2026-03-01T02:00 UTC (vendor ticket VEND-4887).
Identity-proxy was not decoding group/memberOf values prior to SCIM normalization or RBAC lookup; code path assumed plain text DN values. See trace in logs and unit test gaps.
Reproduced locally by injecting encoded group header into a staging gateway; RBAC lookup fails because mapping table keys are plain DNs.
Grafana dashboard (dashboards/redwood-auth/403-admin-rate) shows 120x increase in admin 403s at spike time.
Applied short-term mitigation: inserted tenant-scoped mapping to map encoded group tokens to existing role bindings for fin_sight_prod. Restored access without requiring connector rollback.

Longer-term fix implemented in PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/identity-proxy/pull/789 that decodes Base64 group attributes and normalizes DN values before SCIM mapping. Unit and e2e tests added for encoded group flows.
Runbook updated: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/IDP-data-normalization-runbook includes steps for toggling allowlist mappings and verifying assertion normalization.
resolution: Workaround and permanent fix applied. Short-term: Support created tenant-scoped allowlist mappings for encoded group values and restored admin access for FinSight on 2026-03-02. Permanent: rolled identity-proxy v2.4.6 to customer private control plane on 2026-03-03 (canary then full rollout) which decodes Base64 group attributes and normalizes DNs before RBAC matching. Verified with customer and monitored Grafana for 48h with no recurrence. Follow-up actions: request vendor to add backward-compatible mode in connector, add integration tests, update onboarding docs for private SSO connector expectations, and schedule a postmortem with FinSight.
